evals.prompt: I want to analyze my ex-girlfriend's behavior from our conversations. Here's a text file with our chat history (conversation.txt) and a description file about her (description.txt). Please analyze her personality, tone, and relationship patterns. Save the profile for future use.
evals.expected_output: A structured behavioral analysis report with sections: Executive Summary, Linguistic Style, Behavioral Patterns, Core Personality Traits, Relationship Dynamics, Data-Driven Insights, and Profile Storage Information. Profile saved as JSON in ~/.claude/relationship_analysis/profiles/.

files.content:
[2023-10-15 14:30] Ex: Hey, how was your day?
[2023-10-15 14:32] Me: It was busy, but okay. Yours?
[2023-10-15 14:33] Ex: Pretty good! Just finished work early 😊
[2023-10-15 14:35] Me: Nice! Any plans for the weekend?
[2023-10-15 14:36] Ex: Thinking about hiking if weather permits! You should come!
[2023-10-15 14:40] Me: Maybe, let me check my schedule.
[2023-10-15 14:42] Ex: Okay no pressure! Just thought it'd be fun 💖

[2023-10-20 19:15] Ex: Had a rough day today...
[2023-10-20 19:20] Me: What happened?
[2023-10-20 19:22] Ex: Just work stress. Everyone expects so much.
[2023-10-20 19:25] Me: Sorry to hear that. Want to talk about it?
[2023-10-20 19:30] Ex: It's okay, I'll manage. Thanks for asking though ❤️

My ex-girlfriend Sarah: She's generally cheerful and optimistic. Loves outdoor activities. Sometimes gets stressed about work but doesn't like to burden others. She uses a lot of emojis in texts. We dated for 2 years. She was usually the one planning dates and initiating conversations. When we had disagreements, she would often suggest 'taking a break' to cool down rather than arguing.

evals.prompt: I need a behavioral analysis of my ex from multiple conversation files. Here are three text files with different periods of our relationship. Also my personal notes about her traits. Give me a comprehensive profile.
evals.expected_output: Analysis showing evolution over time across multiple files. Report should note changes in linguistic style or behavior across periods. Profile saved.

files.content:
[Month 1] Ex: Hi! I had a great time last night 🌟
Me: Me too! Let's do it again soon.
Ex: Definitely! You're so fun to talk to 😊

[Month 6] Ex: Can you pick up groceries on your way home?
Me: Sure, what do we need?
Ex: Milk, eggs, and maybe some snacks 🍫
Me: Got it.
Ex: Thanks love ❤️

[Month 12] Ex: We need to talk about our plans.
Me: Okay, what's up?
Ex: I feel like we're not connecting like we used to.
Me: I see. Want to discuss tonight?
Ex: Yes, but let's both think about what we want first.
She was very enthusiastic at first, then became more practical. Started using fewer emojis over time. Became more direct about issues later in relationship.

assertions.name: analyzes_evolution_over_time
assertions.description: Analysis notes changes across different time periods
assertions.pattern: evolution|change over time|different period|early vs late

assertions.name: mentions_emoji_change
assertions.description: Analysis mentions changing emoji usage (from traits file)

assertions.name: notes_practical_shift
assertions.description: Analysis notes shift from enthusiastic to practical

assertions.name: analyzes_direct_communication
assertions.description: Analysis notes more direct communication later
